notes.title: Our 3rd Title Goosey Guess Is Available Now
notes.content:
[b]Gas Lantern Games has released our 3rd title Goosey Guess. It is available on steam now! If you are interested in trying Goosey Guess and you already own Ant Empire, you are eligible for a free key! Please join us in Discord and message Zenkar or Jayann for your free key today!  If you are a content creator interested in doing key giveaways on your channel, contact us in Discord and we will be happy to provide you some additional keys.[url=https://discord.gg/mKhzs8ytap]https://discord.gg/mKhzs8ytap[/url][/b]

It's a game as old as time but with a goosey modern twist. Dozens, and even hundreds of items spawn and drop into various containers. Your challenge? To accurately guess the number of items inside each container. The game is easy to play but difficult to master.

[b]This game features:[/b]
Realistic 3D arts & sound
[list]
[*] True to life physics
[*] A detailed tracking system
[*] Over 40 minutes of original goose themed music
[*] 3 modes of play (freeplay, practice and leaderboard)
[*] 4 levels of difficulty (simple, moderate, challenging and goosey)
[/list]
[b]The following features will be expanded upon in future updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] 19 items
[*] 21 containers
[*] 2 unique scene settings
[/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2258090/Goosey_Guess/

notes.title: Loading Error Resolved
notes.content:
There seems to have been an uncaught bug from beta testing in which our friends across the seas from the United States were getting stuck in the menus and unable to play the game. This was an error caused by how different countries around the world view (and ultimately parse) numbers. For example, 23.567 is a different value in the United States than countries that use a comma for decimals.

This bug has been resolved and no other issues appear to be happening, even small. Apologies to anyone that was affected by this bug. I will happily refund your purchase myself if you would like, please reach out to me.

As far as what is next, new content and additions can be made upon request and assuming can be reasonably done. If you have any ideas or thoughts on certain mechanics, please let me know! And if you happen to run into any issue or glitch, please submit a bug from within the game in the top left corner of the main menu.

Thanks again for everyone's support!

notes.title: Ant Empire Releases!
notes.content:
Ant Empire has finally released for PC and is available for everyone to play! There have been remarkable results and more happy gamers than I could not have anticipated coming from a solo indie developer. 

I am continuing to resolve any issues people are seeing, but [b]PLEASE[/b] report them if you are seeing anything unusual. A very small number of players are seeing some issues with menus not loading correctly, and I am unable to replicate these issues on my own as they seem to be computer architecture related.

In addition, if you have an idea or a suggestion for Ant Empire, feel free to send that along as well. If enough people are interested, we can add more species, maps, and additional content! Or just change how something works!

Thanks again for everyone's support!

notes.title: Lots Of Updates! Getting Ready For Testing
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Sorry for the lack of updates. I plan on providing more frequent updates as launch gets closer. For now, I have been finalizing many mechanics and adding some additional features to allow for the UI to give a better experience.


[u][b]Achievements[/b][/u]
Achievements have received a huge update and are ready to integrate with Steam. The icons are still in progress, but there will be over 40 different achievements that can be tracked in the game or through Steam. A pop-up within the game lets you know every 25% towards an achievement that is earned. (Actual icons for achievements are still being worked on)
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33591193/ad66af6601e3bb40beddc1c0d11de0dd5afbbb0f.png[/img]


[u][b]Ant Stats[/b][/u]
The stats screen has been updated to compare a bit more easily the strengths and weaknesses of each ant with visual indicators.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33591193/acb87b4f2b02dde349c21a648a1dde7dc3c714a4.png[/img]


[u][b]Other UI Updates[/b][/u]
Many other UI changes have taken place. The species selection screen is now broken down into tabs and is easier to navigate.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33591193/5200b4410045e8a0831f544115c702aece7befc6.png[/img]


[u][b]Tactical Colony Info[/b][/u]
This is one of my favorite changes. The Tactical screen now displays the health of each colony and its rating. Everything can still be hovered on to provide additional information, but this change allows the player to see everything at once and make decisions a bit more easily.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33591193/9473cdfe82268611ee7a2974c8e8fc8f136c86f1.png[/img]


[u][b]Campaign[/b][/u]
The campaign is being finalized, but is completed for the most part. Select a species and pick from several different battles to play. Each battle is on a different map and has randomized objectives, events, rewards, opponents, and more. There are dozens of different types of objectives, ranging from gathering food, spending research, dealing damage, and many more. After a battle is won (or lost... you get 3 lives) you get points to spend for bonuses that remain for the rest of the campaign. [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33591193/91988880ac2f5ffd98e1773e67d399af56aec32d.png[/img]

notes.title: New Features Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

I have been busy creating some more features and mechanics the last few weeks for Ant Empire, and am ready to share these.

[list]
    [*]3 "Traits" have been created for each species
    [*]6 New Research Upgrades (32 total)
    [*]2 New Perks (12 total)
    [*]1 New Map (5 total)
    [*]1 New Colony Focus
    [*]Influence Re-work
[/list]



[h1]Traits[/h1]

[b][u]Sugar[/u][/b]
[b]Food Trackers[/b] - Minor and major workers have a 2% chance to eat enemy food while attacking
[b]Polygynists[/b] - The Polygyne research is completed
[b]Storage Experts[/b] - Food storage costs are reduced by 20%

[b][u]Fire[/u][/b]
[b]Formic Acid[/b] - Soldiers and Super Soldiers have a 4% chance to lower enemy production
[b]Twin Soldiers[/b] - Soldiers have a 3% chance of being born with a twin
[b]Ruthless[/b] - Starts with Return Attacker 2

[b][u]Carpenter[/u][/b]
[b]Resourceful[/b] - Bonus tiles cost the same as regular tiles
[b]Offensive Defense[/b] - Nests recieve a 2% bonus to defense while attacking
[b]Nuisance[/b] - New nests start with 11 influence
 
[b][u]Leafcutter[/u][/b]
[b]Fungus Gardens[/b] - Colony grows fungus automatically from nest size
[b]Tunnel Bandits[/b] - Soldiers and Super Soldiers have a 4% chance to reduce enemy colony's nest size
[b]Nest Specialists[/b] - Nests can grow larger by 15 cubic centimeters

[b][u]Army[/u][/b]
[b]Genesis[/b] - Soldiers have a 2% chance of mutating into a princess while hatching
[b]Relocate Bivouac[/b] - Bivouacs can be relocated using influence and gain permanent bonuses
[b]Territorial[/b] - Tiles can't be flipped by enemies and cannot claim tiles



[h1]Research[/h1]

[b]Queen Comfort[/b] - Gain Production from stored food
[b]Workforce[/b] - Workers cost less influence to purchase
[b]Renown[/b] - Each Princess gives an attack bonus
[b]Clout[/b] - Queens generate influence
[b]Variable Diet[/b] - Workers that are foraging have a chance to eat without using stored food
[b]Outposts[/b] - Each tile owned in excess of 20 gives a small amount of production



[h1]Perks[/h1]

[b]Influential[/b] - Gain range when claiming tiles for the Colony
[b]Add Queen[/b] - Adds a Queen to the Colony (also requires 2 princesses and Polygyne)



[h1]New Map[/h1]

Farm has been added as the 5th map, and the 2nd map that is for 3-players.



[h1]Colony Focus[/h1]

Colony Pride has been added as a focus, increasing all influence gained by 15%.



[h1]Influence Re-work[/h1]

Currently, Influence is used for claiming tiles and removing enemy claims on the map. Workers can now be purchased at the cost of influence. 

Princesses also give influence each turn, and give less production.


There are tons of other changes and updates, but those are some of the more notable ones. Thanks for everyone's support!


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33591193/787d3cd303a9ff3cf842d5ccebf091922e0861da.png[/img]
